flake_dir.label: Flake directory
flake_dir.description: Directory containing your system flake.nix. Its flake.lock is only read, never modified.

host.label: NixOS configuration
host.description: nixosConfigurations attribute to check. Leave empty to use this machine's hostname.

compare.label: Compare against
compare.description: Latest upstream: the newest version of every flake input. Git remote: the flake.lock on the remote branch, for machines that only pull a lock another machine updates (no GitHub API calls).

include_flatpak.label: Include Flatpak updates
include_flatpak.description: Also list pending Flatpak updates, user and system installations.

update_method.label: Update method
update_method.description: What "Update now" runs. The default updates the flake inputs and switches with plain nixos-rebuild.

custom_command.label: Custom command
custom_command.description: Shell command run in the terminal, e.g. topgrade, or zsh -ic nru for a shell function.

terminal.label: Terminal command
terminal.description: Prefix that runs a command in a terminal, e.g. kitty --class nix-updates -e. Leave empty to use $TERMINAL.

check_interval.label: Check every
check_interval.description: How often to look for updates in the background. The first check runs 15 seconds after login unless one ran in the last 30 minutes; failed checks retry after 1, 5, then 15 minutes.
